lines.text: For I have endured scorn for Your sake,
and shame has covered my face.
I have become a stranger to my brothers
and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,
because zeal for Your house has consumed me,
and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.
and I was sport to them.
Those who sit at the gate mock me,
and I am the song of drunkards.
But my prayer to You, O LORD,
is for a time of favor.
In Your abundant loving devotion, O God,
answer me with Your sure salvation.

pictures.scene: Moritz Daniel Oppenheim, Wekenfeest - a household of Israel keeping the feast together in their own room, O God of Israel, for I have endured scorn for Your sake
pictures.name: pd_oppenheim_wekenfeest

pictures.scene: Jakub Schikaneder, Avondstraat - a lone figure walking an empty evening street past shuttered houses, shame has covered my face and I have become a stranger to my brothers
pictures.name: pd_schikaneder_avondstraat

pictures.scene: John Pettie, De wake van de ridder - a young man keeping his night vigil alone before the altar, a foreigner to my mother's sons because zeal for Your house has consumed me
pictures.name: pd_pettie_wake_van_de_ridder

pictures.scene: Emile Friant, Allerheiligen - mourners filing past the graveyard gate on All Saints' day with a beggar's hand held out to them, the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me, I wept and fasted
pictures.name: pd_friant_allerheiligen

pictures.scene: Carl Spitzweg, Aswoensdag - a man shut in a bare cell on Ash Wednesday in his penitent's clothes, it brought me reproach and I made sackcloth my clothing
pictures.name: pd_spitzweg_aswoensdag

pictures.scene: Vasily Perov, Kloostermaaltijd - the well-fed men at the refectory table laughing while the poor stand unnoticed at the door, I was sport to them and those who sit at the gate mock me
pictures.name: pd_perov_kloostermaaltijd

pictures.scene: Carl Bloch, In een Romeinse herberg - the tavern company loud over their wine, and I am the song of drunkards
pictures.name: pd_bloch_in_een_romeinse_herberg

pictures.scene: John Glover, Landschap bij Patterdale - the long valley opening into clear light with the lake quiet below, my prayer to You is for a time of favor
pictures.name: pd_glover_landschap_bij_patterdale

pictures.scene: Constantin Meunier, Mijnwerkers bij de schacht - miners hauled up out of the pit at the end of the shift, answer me with Your sure salvation and rescue me from the mire
pictures.name: pd_meunier_mijnwerkers_bij_de_schacht
